strings.zh: 好了,听好哦豪力,{NEWLINE}帮我移动那个行李！{SCROLL}
strings.en: All right, listen up, Machoke.{NEWLINE}Help me move that load!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 换了豪力之后,{NEWLINE}原本很费力的活一下就完成了！{SCROLL}但我觉得老板愿意提高成本{NEWLINE}把腕力换成豪力,{CLEAR}并不是因为他良心发现,{CLEAR}而是因为你来过。
strings.en: Now that we have Machoke, jobs that{NEWLINE}used to be so hard get done in no time!{SCROLL}But I don’t think the boss agreed{NEWLINE}to raise his costs and swap Machop{CLEAR}for Machoke because his conscience{CLEAR}kicked in. It’s because you came by.

strings.zh: 豪力『Maaaa——cho！
strings.en: Machoke: Maaaa-cho!

strings.zh: 这些箱子太重了,腕力根本推不动嘛。{SCROLL}
strings.en: These crates are too heavy.{NEWLINE}Machop can’t push them at all.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 换豪力来做应该就能推动了
strings.en: Machoke could push these

strings.zh: 不关我事
strings.en: Not my problem

strings.zh: 我们也想换豪力来做啊,{NEWLINE}可惜老板不给配豪力,{CLEAR}只分给我们腕力来干这些活。
strings.en: We want Machoke to do it too, but{NEWLINE}the boss won’t give us Machoke. He{CLEAR}only gives us Machop for this work.

strings.zh: 多亏了口袋妖怪的帮助,{NEWLINE}干这些重体力活{CLEAR}再也不需要那么多人力了。
strings.en: Thanks to Pokémon, heavy{NEWLINE}labor like this doesn’t take{CLEAR}nearly as many people anymore.

strings.zh: 腕力干活太吃力,该换豪力了
strings.en: Too hard for Machop; use Machoke
strings.notes: Moving-company boss debate: menus #4/#5, #8, #10/#11, #13/#14, #17/#18; player lines #21-#24; battle #19/#20.

strings.zh: 你说的太轻巧了,{NEWLINE}换豪力来做不得加钱啊？{CLEAR}豪力吃的可比腕力多多了。{CLEAR}而且大部分活腕力都能做,{CLEAR}就为了那几个重箱子,{CLEAR}我就改养豪力,你觉得合适吗？
strings.en: Easy for you to say. Using Machoke{NEWLINE}costs more, doesn’t it? Machoke{CLEAR}eats way more than Machop. And{CLEAR}Machop can do most of the jobs.{CLEAR}You think I should start keeping{CLEAR}Machoke just for a few heavy crates?

strings.zh: 这样超极限干活很伤身体
strings.en: Overwork is bad for their bodies

strings.zh: 你说的对
strings.en: You’re right

strings.zh: 我开搬运公司,{NEWLINE}是为了赚钱不是为了做慈善。{CLEAR}你那么有爱心,你出钱开个疗养公司{CLEAR}给这些干活伤身的精灵疗养呗。
strings.en: I run a moving company to make{NEWLINE}money, not to do charity. If you{CLEAR}care so much, why don’t you pay{CLEAR}to open a rehab center for all{CLEAR}the Pokémon worn out by work?

strings.zh: 保障精灵健康是你的义务
strings.en: Their health is your duty

strings.zh: 我没那么多钱
strings.en: I don’t have that kind of money

strings.zh: 没钱就去赚,{NEWLINE}试过你就知道赚钱的难了。{CLEAR}就不会再说出{CLEAR}让我把腕力换成豪力这样的话了。
strings.en: If you don’t have money, go earn some.{NEWLINE}Once you try, you’ll learn how hard it{CLEAR}is to make money. Then you won’t tell me{CLEAR}to swap my Machop for Machoke anymore.

strings.zh: 我的义务就是赚钱,{NEWLINE}除此之外别跟我扯这些没用的。
strings.en: My duty is to make money. Don’t bother{NEWLINE}me with any of that useless stuff.

strings.zh: 只能用力量教育你了
strings.en: Guess I’ll teach you by force

strings.zh: 算了,懒得理你
strings.en: Forget it, you’re not worth it

strings.zh: 哼,我出来混这么多年,{NEWLINE}看我不顺眼的人一大把,{CLEAR}还真没谁能把我怎么样！
strings.en: Hmph. I’ve been in this business{NEWLINE}for years. Plenty of people can’t{CLEAR}stand me, and not one of them{CLEAR}has ever done a thing about it!

strings.zh: 我认输！我认输！{SCROLL}仔细一想你说的也有道理,{NEWLINE}毕竟口袋妖怪不仅仅是工具,{CLEAR}我在使用它们的时候{CLEAR}确实有义务保障它们的健康。{SCROLL}我以后会给搬运队配几只豪力,{NEWLINE}帮腕力们完成比较重的活。{CLEAR}你放心好啦。
strings.en: I give up! I give up!{SCROLL}Come to think of it, you have a point.{NEWLINE}Pokémon aren’t just tools, after{CLEAR}all. When I use them, it really is{CLEAR}my duty to protect their health.{SCROLL}From now on I’ll give the moving crew{NEWLINE}a few Machoke to help the Machop with{CLEAR}the heavier jobs. You can rest easy.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我看你们这的腕力,{NEWLINE}在推重箱子的时候很吃力,{CLEAR}是不是换豪力来更好一些？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Your Machop are really{NEWLINE}struggling to push those heavy crates.{CLEAR}Wouldn’t it be better to use Machoke?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『可是长期超出极限干活,{NEWLINE}对腕力们的身体很不好啊。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: But working past{NEWLINE}their limits for so long is really{CLEAR}bad for the Machop’s health.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『你是口袋妖怪的使用者,{NEWLINE}在享有它们劳动成果的同时,{CLEAR}也应该保障它们的健康,{CLEAR}这是法律给你规定的义务。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: You use these Pokémon. While{NEWLINE}you enjoy the fruits of their labor,{CLEAR}you should also protect their health.{CLEAR}That’s a duty the law places on you.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『看来对于你们这种人,{NEWLINE}讲道理是不管用的。{CLEAR}那就别怪我用力量纠正你的观点了。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Looks like reasoning{NEWLINE}doesn’t work on people like{CLEAR}you. Then don’t blame me for{CLEAR}correcting your views by force.

strings.zh: 唉,腕力换成豪力,{NEWLINE}每个月净利润得少5个百分点。
strings.en: Sigh. Swapping Machop for Machoke is{NEWLINE}going to take 5 percentage points off{CLEAR}my monthly net profit.
strings.notes: | RV034: meaning: 5个百分点 = five percentage points (D-1710)

strings.zh: 听说老板要把腕力换成豪力,{NEWLINE}这下工作就轻松多了。
strings.en: I heard the boss is swapping the{NEWLINE}Machop for Machoke. Our work’s{CLEAR}going to be way easier now.

strings.zh: 好了,听好哦腕力,{NEWLINE}帮我移动那个箱子！{SCROLL}
strings.en: All right, listen up, Machop.{NEWLINE}Help me move that crate!{SCROLL}

strings.en: Machop: Maa...
